Sparkling Tones for desktop, part six: the looper.
In the live view, click "Looper": it drives the looper built into your Spark 2.
Pick the length in bars, the tempo, or tap it in, and whether you want a count-in and a click.
Hit "Record": the count-in plays, then the amp records, and the ring shows where you are in the loop.
Hit it again to overdub. "Undo" takes back the last layer, "Stop" halts the loop, "Clear" starts over.
With a MIDI footswitch, one click lays out the looper on your switches, just like our pedal.
Sparkling Tones: free, for Windows and in your browser.
